headline: Sharjah archaeologists uncover rare 7000 year old rock carvings depicting sea turtles
label: NEWS
caption:
Archaeologists in Sharjah have made a remarkable discovery in the mountains.

According to reports from Gulf News and The National, researchers found five rare rock carvings dating back 7,000 years.

The ancient carvings specifically depict sea turtles, offering a rare glimpse into the region's prehistoric past.

Experts are continuing to study the site to learn more about the ancient communities that once lived there.
